title: gawk variables
description: Configuration variables for gawk across POSIX, Windows native (MSVC), and MS-DOS (dos32).

GAWK_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install gawk. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs (dos32 on MS-DOS, PE on Windows), 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

GAWK_VERSION.description: Specific version of gawk to install (e.g., 5.4.60 on Windows/MS-DOS, 5.3.1 on POSIX, or latest).

GAWK_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading gawk binary or archive artifacts.

GAWK_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying gawk available remote releases.
